findings.passage: Makes it illegal to possess devices that convert semi-automatic firearms into fully automatic machine guns.
findings.note: Newsletter summary of S.2572 (Senate gun bill debated Feb 1, 2024); she reports the bill bans machine-gun conversion devices.

findings.passage: Creates a criminal charge for intentionally firing a firearm at a dwelling or other building in use.
findings.note: Newsletter summary of S.2572 provision on firing at buildings.

findings.passage: The bill also enhances requirements for reporting lost, stolen and surrendered firearms.
findings.note: Newsletter describing S.2572 provisions; she also says her work was driven by an interest in reducing gun violence.

findings.passage: The legislation criminalizes discharging firearms at or near dwellings.
findings.note: Newsletter describing S.2572 provisions. The page also says the bill requires registration and serialization of frames and receivers (ghost guns) and bars carry on school buses, polling places and government buildings (fetch tool gave only fragments of those sentences).

findings.passage: Massachusetts has some of the strongest common sense gun laws in the country
findings.note: From the 'On gun safety' section after the Supreme Court gun ruling (Bruen); fetch tool returned this as a fragment without final punctuation. She also promises to work to protect the state's safeguards.
